Physicist Lawrence Krauss brings Rogan what he calls the mindblower of mindblowers in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Krauss, known for books on the physics of the cosmos, has a gift for picking the one idea that reorders a layman's picture of reality. Here he aims high.

He walks Rogan through the idea step by step, from the basic facts to the strange place they lead. Rogan plays the amazed student, stopping him where the logic bends. The segment is a compact piece of science theater: a famous explainer delivering his most staggering claim to the biggest audience in podcasting.
